title: Multi-Signal Adaptive Search Controller v2
v2_changes: Keep the unified uncertainty architecture but make it ablation-friendly.
Use controller output only for LMR and child-node futility in v2.
Return null-move pruning and razoring to parent behavior.
Reduce root-volatility and root-churn contribution to uncertainty.
Reduce LMR amplitude by roughly half versus v1.
Activate the controller only from depth 11 upward to protect the hot shallow tree.
Use smoother thresholds so low/high confidence effects are less abrupt.

parent_screen.termination: GitHub Actions job timeout at 210 minutes during game 360; no engine crash detected.

stockfish_latest_baseline.interpretation: Positive point estimate against the Stockfish master fetched at run start; confidence interval overlaps zero, so this is baseline evidence rather than a claim of statistically established superiority.

followup_ablations.lmr_only: approximately neutral against the same Stockfish reference
followup_ablations.conclusion: Further FAYE-0008 micro-calibration is retired. Preserve v2 unchanged as the project baseline and move to a new major architecture experiment.

promotion.basis: Promoted by project owner, retained after a completed 600-game Stockfish-latest baseline screen and focused ablations.
promotion.strength_claim: official-project-baseline; no claim of statistically established superiority over Stockfish
promotion.next_protocol: FAYE-0009 and later primary experiments start from this promoted main baseline plus one major focused architecture change, and are evaluated against official-stockfish/Stockfish master fetched at run time with recorded SHAs.

decision_policy: FAYE-0008 is closed. Do not continue parameter micro-tuning as the primary roadmap. FAYE-0009 begins from the promoted v2 baseline.
